name: Shenyang Geumpungri Network Technology Co., Ltd.

attribution.legal_posture: Current OFAC exact-ID component-table data confirms the administrative-list entry and adds only the bounded structured context stated here. The record describes an IT-worker front/company subordinate to Chinyong IT and a PRC front company in a DPRK IT-worker network under an administrative sanctions designation; criminal charge or conviction is outside this designation.

caveats: Administrative sanctions state an administrative status; criminal charges and convictions require separate proceedings.
Sanctions-list address context is historical location context; present physical location, current operations, ownership, employment, or control require current evidence.
SDN.CSV, ADD.CSV, and ALT.CSV are component tables of one current OFAC dataset and count as one source family.
Street and postal addresses, birth data, passports, government and company identifiers, email addresses, financial selectors, and sanctions boilerplate are excluded.
The classification and link are source context; current operations and control status remain unverified.
